impact_assessment.why: R7 requires far transfer measured separately; near-only measurement cannot detect (or honestly deny) far transfer, and the trial needs a far outcome

impact_assessment.mitigation: separate store/screen/schedule; seeded deterministic order; no effect on history, motivation or adaptive

[1/2] Plan: optional clock hiding grounded in test-anxiety meta-analysis

impact_assessment.why: Anxiety impairs performance and perceived time pressure raises anxiety (238-study meta-analysis); untimed beats timed, most for the anxious
impact_assessment.benefits: anxious and older users can train without a ticking clock; default unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: display-only toggle, default off; no timing logic changes; lint-checked copy
